items.title: Kargoyu sormak
items.situation: You ordered a pair of shoes ten days ago and they have not arrived. You call the shop.
items.situationTr: On gün önce bir çift ayakkabı sipariş ettin ve gelmedi. Mağazayı arıyorsun.
prompts: Say what you ordered and when.
Explain that it has not arrived.
Give your order number.
Ask what they can do.
promptsTr: Ne sipariş ettiğini ve ne zaman ettiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I ordered a pair of shoes on the fifth of March.
usefulPhrases.tr: Beş Mart'ta bir çift ayakkabı sipariş ettim.

usefulPhrases.en: They still have not arrived.
My order number is four seven two one.
usefulPhrases.tr: Sipariş numaram dört yedi iki bir.

usefulPhrases.en: Could you check where the package is?
If it is lost, I would like my money back.

items.title: Bir daireye bakmak
items.situation: You are visiting an apartment you may rent. Ask the owner your questions.
items.situationTr: Kiralayabileceğin bir daireyi geziyorsun. Ev sahibine sorularını sor.
prompts: Ask about the rent and the bills.
Ask how many rooms there are.
Ask about buses and shops nearby.
Say what you think of the apartment.

usefulPhrases.en: How much is the rent each month?
Are the bills included?
How far is the bus stop?
The kitchen is smaller than I expected.
I like it, but I need to think about it.

items.title: Spor salonu üyeliği
items.situation: You want to join a gym near your home. Talk to the person at the desk.
items.situationTr: Evine yakın bir spor salonuna yazılmak istiyorsun. Danışmadaki kişiyle konuş.
prompts: Say why you want to join.
Ask about the prices.
Ask when the gym is open.
Ask if you can try it first.
promptsTr: Salonun ne zaman açık olduğunu sor.

usefulPhrases.en: I want to get fit before the summer.
How much is it for three months?
What time do you open at the weekend?
Can I try it for one day first?
Do I need to bring my own towel?

items.title: Buluşmayı başka güne almak
items.situation: You cannot meet your friend on Saturday any more. Call her and change the day.
items.situationTr: Cumartesi arkadaşınla buluşamayacaksın. Onu ara ve günü değiştir.
prompts: Say that you cannot come on Saturday.
Explain why.
Suggest another day.
Say you are sorry.

usefulPhrases.en: I am afraid I cannot come on Saturday.
My brother is arriving that morning.
Could we meet on Sunday instead?
I am really sorry about this.
Any time after two is fine for me.
usefulPhrases.tr: İkiden sonra her saat benim için uygun.

items.title: Kuaförde
items.situation: You are at the hairdresser. Explain what you want and answer her questions.
items.situationTr: Kuafördesin. Ne istediğini anlat ve sorularını yanıtla.
prompts: Say what you would like.
Say how short you want it.
Say when you were here last.
Ask how much it will cost.
promptsTr: En son ne zaman geldiğini söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I would like a haircut, please.
Not too short at the back.
I was here about two months ago.
How much will that be?
That is fine, thank you.
